Constraints: genuine transparent alpha background, clean antialiased edges, one connected usable art layer; absolutely no head, face, hair, hat, new accessories, text, logo, watermark, scenery, solid background, checkerboard painted into pixels, outer glow or halo. Do not output a full character or multiple panels. Deliver only the single continuous body asset.
